summary: End-to-end testing of KisanMitra AI (fresh first iteration). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate), schemes, guide, farms CRUD, tasks CRUD, and the four AI endpoints (/assess, /chat, /daily-plan, /schemes/match) plus /tts audio. Frontend: 15/15 Playwright checks pass covering register->home, JWT storage in localStorage, Try Demo prefill, Analyze flow (assessment with Needs Attention returned), Why toggle, Save as Task, Tasks tab load, Schemes list (8) + search + detail (official source + Remind Me), Assistant chat reply, Guide articles (7), Language switch to Hindi (UI labels translated in Settings), Settings page with logout+delete. Assessment history persisted via /api/history.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 491 lines and mixes auth, LLM, schemes, CRUD, STT/TTS in a single module. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, ai.py, crud.py, voice.py) as feature set grows.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True. FastAPI silently ignores credentials with '*' origins. Not currently affecting JWT (Bearer, not cookies), but worth tightening for production.
JWT_SECRET falls back to 'dev-secret' if env var missing - fine for preview but must be set in prod.
/api/farms and /api/tasks accept unvalidated raw JSON bodies (no Pydantic schema). Recommend adding models for input validation and consistent 422 errors.
STT endpoint does not validate audio content-type or file size limit - potential abuse vector.
Assessment prompt asks for strict JSON; if LLM ever returns non-JSON despite strip_json, endpoint 502s (already handled gracefully). Consider a retry-with-repair fallback.
test_credentials: admin@kisanmitra.ai / admin123 (seeded); freshly registered test users via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: Test suite registers ephemeral TEST_farmer_<uuid>@test.com users and cleans account data via DELETE /api/account/data in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope, but session-scoped fixtures duplicate the register call per worker so serial -n 0 is cleaner). AI endpoints take 5-30s each, so full suite takes ~50s. Frontend UI verified on mobile viewport (390x844). Voice STT was not exercised with real audio; /api/tts was verified to return audio/mpeg. Farm Supplies opens Google Maps in new tab (expected).
